# HubSpot Certification

> Free professional certification and training courses covering inbound marketing, marketing AI, and HubSpot platform expertise.

HubSpot Certification offers comprehensive courses including inbound marketing certification with real-world case studies and master classes on emerging topics like AI in marketing. The platform features expert instructors and is available in multiple languages including Portuguese.

## Key Topics

- Inbound Marketing
- HubSpot CRM
- Marketing Automation
- Artificial Intelligence
- Marketing Strategy
- Lead Management
- HubSpot Academy
- Certification
- Free Courses
- Analytics
- Email Marketing
- Marketing Technology
- Machine Learning
- Sales Platform

## Certification Courses

- [Inbound Marketing Certification](https://certification.hubspot.com/certificacao-inbound-empresas): Free inbound marketing certification course with case studies showing how companies utilize HubSpot's inbound methodology

## Master Classes & Advanced Training

- [Marketing AI with Paul Roetzer](https://certification.hubspot.com/master-class/paul-roetzer-marketing-artificial-intelligence): Expert master class on artificial intelligence applications in marketing featuring Paul Roetzer and HubSpot Academy
